meta.title: VAYA — Your trusted ride, every day
meta.description: Real drivers, verified profiles, and a fair price for every trip. VAYA is structured carpooling for Tunisia.

hero.headline: Your trusted ride, every day.
hero.subhead: Real drivers, verified profiles, and a fair price for every trip.

steps.label: Where to?
steps.title: Tell VAYA where you're going
steps.body: Search your route. VAYA looks for real drivers already heading your way — not just ones who happen to start exactly where you are.

steps.label: Pick your stop
steps.title: Choose a real, road-checked pickup point
steps.body: Never drop a pin in the middle of nowhere. VAYA offers a small, ranked set of real spots along the driver's actual route.

steps.label: See the price
steps.title: A fair price, before you commit
steps.body: Every trip shows a computed price range from real distance and time — never a guess, never a bidding war.

steps.label: Request
steps.title: Request your seat
steps.body: One tap. The driver is notified instantly.

steps.label: Accepted
steps.title: The driver accepts
steps.body: Your seat is confirmed — track the ride and message your driver right from the app.

steps.label: Empty seat, filled
steps.title: The driver earns on a trip they were already making
steps.body: No detour, no new trip — just a seat that would have gone empty, now covering the cost of the road.

passenger.title: A ride that's actually going your way
passenger.body: Most carpooling apps match you to a driver's exact start and end point. VAYA looks at the whole route — so a driver passing near you counts too.

points.title: Search once, see real options
points.body: Rides ranked by how well they match your route and your time, not just the closest pin.

points.title: A pickup point you can trust
points.body: Every suggested stop is checked against the real road — no impossible pickups, no guessing.

points.title: See who's driving, before you request
points.body: Rating, trip history and verification status are visible before you ever commit to a seat.

driver.title: Turn empty seats into income
driver.body: You're already making the trip. VAYA fills the seats that would otherwise ride empty — with real people going your way, matched to your actual route.

points.title: Publish your route in minutes
points.body: VAYA maps your trip on real roads and suggests road-checked pickup points along the way.

points.title: A price that's fair to set
points.body: A computed price range from real distance and duration — you choose within it, never a free-for-all.

points.title: Riders who know the rules
points.body: Clear pickup points, visible pricing, and a rating system that rewards reliability on both sides.

matching.title: VAYA finds rides going your way — not just your exact route
matching.body: Underneath every search is a real routing engine, built on Tunisia's actual road network. VAYA checks whether a driver's route genuinely passes near you — even mid-trip — before ever showing you a match.

tiers.title: On your exact route
tiers.body: A driver going from your start to your end.

tiers.title: Close enough to walk
tiers.body: A driver whose route runs near enough to your trip.

tiers.title: Passing through
tiers.body: A driver whose route runs through your corridor, even if their own trip goes further.

tiers.title: Closest departure
tiers.body: Nothing at your exact time? VAYA shows the next best departure on the same corridor.

trust.title: Know who you're riding with, before you book
trust.body: Trust has to be visible before commitment, not discovered after the fact.

points.title: Live-camera verification
points.body: Every driver verifies identity through a live camera check — never an uploaded photo from a gallery.

points.title: Ratings you see first
points.body: Reliability, punctuality and trip history are shown before you request a seat, not after.

points.title: A policy that protects both sides
points.body: Clear cancellation and no-show rules, applied the same way for passengers and drivers.

product.title: This is the actual VAYA app
product.body: No mockups standing in for the product — this is what booking a real trip looks like.

finalCta.title: Your next ride is already on the road.
finalCta.body: Download VAYA and see who's going your way.
